elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause contains no commercial general liability aggregate requirement.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires professional liability insurance of only USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Processing of Customer Data is not demonstrably absent, and the clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of only USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause contains no obligation to provide certificates of insurance.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added provision requires Array to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added provision requires Array to maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the stated fallback limits for E&O and cyber/privacy insurance but omits the preferred CGL, workers' compensation, certificate, and higher-limit requirements. The existing counterparts and language provisions remain unchanged, and no unrelated obligation is added. Drafting quality is low because the new provision is inserted as an unnumbered standalone paragraph beneath Section 18.14 rather than as a properly numbered insurance section.
